title: Not responding message happens a lot
body:
I have been running xDrip for about 11 months. I have updated the app whenever it notifies me of a new release. 

I am currently running version : 14a03a7-2019.05.18

Running the beta update channel. 

XDrip is configured to read my libre via a miaomiao and I have xDrip uploading to 2 nightscout cloud uploader endpoints. 

I perform blood glucose calibrations every day, and have therefore accrued 10 months of calibration entries. 

I *frequently* find that the app freezes for long durations, and additionally takes a very long time for the menu button to appear on the top left of the app screen when loading. 

Please see below the not responding notification as a screenshot. 

![Screenshot_20190721_195335_com android chrome](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/831013/61605749-c8789f00-abfb-11e9-915a-32435e3fe545.jpg)

Please see the system status screen in this image:

![Screenshot_20190722_102109_com eveningoutpost dexdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/831013/61651552-f21cdf00-ac6a-11e9-9c9c-0885e52fb016.jpg)


Any and all advice on how to improve the performance of the app / remove this responding problem would be very much appreciated

comments.body: Could you please upload an image of the system status as well?
Same thing here for a couple of weeks now.
@AdrianLxM please see the updated issue with attached system status screenshot.

Ok, you started the sensor a year ago ;)
Try stopping and restarting it. Should make DB operations for "current sensor" much quicker.

I was also a tad confused by that! So what exactly is that saying? Do I need to manually do this everytime I use a new sensor? I would've thought this was automatic when the sensor age goes backwards.
I have this, too and do the start/stop with every new sensor.
This has helped a lot -- I have not seen the not responding since performing this fix. However - the app still takes too long when opening for the menu button to appear. What would cause that delay?

Hey guys, still having this "not responding" thing every time i open xdrip now. This is very annoying. Sometimes i have to try it three times until it works. Any suggestion here? I stop/start the sensor with every change.

@renegadeandy Would you please close this issue if it was resolved?
Otherwise, you can use the support channels.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
